# An evolving map of Live

We know much more about **what is packaged with Live** than about **how its main
native program is organized**. This atlas makes that distinction visible. It
explains relationships already supported by retained evidence and links their
canonical findings; it is not a recovered original architecture document.
Start with the [method guide](learning/method.md) for the vocabulary.

## Native component layer and indirect resolution — 2026-10-20

The amended [execution plan](full-live-specification-plan.md#amendment--indirect-call-resolution-precedes-the-map-2026-10-20)
selects component/dispatch recovery before the integration map. Its
[packet 1a](../../analysis/ableton-live-12.4.3/full-spec-v1/component-resolution-v1/README.md)
[passed independent structure review](../../analysis/ableton-live-12.4.3/full-spec-v1/reviews/component-resolution-v1-review.json).
The following inventories support bounded scenario search; they do not by
themselves select semantic component edges. All belong to the pinned main arm64 image, SHA256
`3a99ceeabce62ccd069b6b55d99d186c9bdf8a6b80a7e3350dd0f9d1c383cfad`.
[Input pins](../../analysis/ableton-live-12.4.3/full-spec-v1/component-resolution-v1/packet-inputs.json)
verify the retained call, indirect, alias, string and named-vtable indexes.

### Lexical component candidates

The [symbol layer](../../analysis/ableton-live-12.4.3/full-spec-v1/component-resolution-v1/symbol-readme.md)
accounts for all 420,470 alias entries. Exactly 45,948 contain qualified labels;
their 38,154 distinct qualified spellings yield 22,548 conservatively parsed lexical
owners. The remaining 374,522 entries remain an explicit pinned-source complement.
The plan amendment's 91,903 qualified names are field occurrences: primary-name
and symbol-array labels repeat. Likewise 39,700 `ableton::` occurrences represent
19,841 distinct labels across 19,850 entries. These are different units, not added
component counts. Template/operator ambiguities, library paths and namespace
versus class interpretation stay explicit in the
[summary](../../analysis/ableton-live-12.4.3/full-spec-v1/component-resolution-v1/symbol-summary.json).
A spelling alone supplies neither a semantic subsystem nor a receiver proof.

### Class/address-point candidates

The read-only [class recovery summary](../../analysis/ableton-live-12.4.3/full-spec-v1/component-resolution-v1/class-summary.json)
records 28,017 normal-dyld-bound typeinfo-layout records, 25,101 distinct literal
type encodings and 25,485 RTTI-header/executable-prefix address points in the
selected `__DATA_CONST/__const` section. Those prefixes contain 458,796 slots,
458,576 of which match retained internal function entries. Slot occurrences can
repeat the same function across tables; they are not distinct function counts.
These are structural matches under declared predicates, not complete original
table extents or runtime class memberships. Name-pointer bit 63 clearing is an explicit candidate
interpretation; missing layouts/imports and capped prefixes remain unresolved.
Lexical literal-store candidates require full receiver/lifetime/native-PC
validation before they can attach a dispatch edge.

The old 80 named-table rows were all checked: 55 address points match the new
selected predicate, 25 remain outside it. Nine of their 2,191 slot-like values are
non-executable; eight are imported RTTI-vptr pseudo-addresses and one is data.
Do not treat the exported slot list as a complete list of callable methods.
The retained old index is unchanged.

### Indirect-site baseline and search boundary

The [indirect census](../../analysis/ableton-live-12.4.3/full-spec-v1/component-resolution-v1/indirect-baseline.json)
verifies 268,015 unique sites across 98,328 functions: 244,762 call-kind sites and
23,253 computed jumps. The amendment's 25,071 resolved count means sites with
nonempty exported target references: 22,873 call-kind and 2,198 jump sites.
Only 21,685 sites have at least one exported target naming a known function.
These denominators are not interchangeable with virtual calls or behavior.
The [resolution overlay](../../analysis/ableton-live-12.4.3/full-spec-v1/component-resolution-v1/indirect-report.json)
adds 24 conditional static records, all previously empty call-kind sites, for
constructed `OSendThreadMessage` receivers at address point `0x106756188`, slot
`+0x10`, target `0x101ab7898`. The exported-or-conditional inventory is therefore
25,095 of 268,015; the original export remains 25,071. Receiver/vptr stability
across any listed opaque calls and ordinary-call premises are explicit; this
is not an unconditional runtime dispatch count. The selected cohort uses the
retained transport sender plus 23 deterministic constructor callers, with exact
native-PC/source/byte evidence. A matching slot offset across unrelated tables
adds no target. No other recovered class is assigned to a site by this packet.

This prerequisite performs no scenario traversal. The integration packet must
state its entry/sink sets, hub-pruning rule, per-level search budget and reviewed
frontiers, retain unresolved indirect sites as unknown edges, and collapse
function-level evidence into observed, inferred or unknown component edges.
No outcome grade, X/S/no-route family count, complete profile or runtime order
follows from this inventory.

## T1 scenario integration map — 2026-10-20

[Packet 1b](../../analysis/ableton-live-12.4.3/full-spec-v1/integration-structure-v1/README.md)
extends the reviewed component layer into one scenario map. The combined packet
[passed independent structure review](../../analysis/ableton-live-12.4.3/full-spec-v1/reviews/integration-structure-v1-review.json). It covers document load, transport,
quantized launch, playback and mixing, recording into Arrangement, save/reopen
and export. Recording/export here are analyst scenario boundaries; they do not
expand ADR 0004's implementation T1 or start its deferred implementation.

This drawing groups **static relationships and explicit missing joins**. Solid
arrows have source-supported local relationships, with semantic owners still
qualified by the table below. Dotted arrows label either a narrow inference or
an unknown bridge. Drawing order is not execution order, thread delivery or
observed audio flow. In particular a stored document graph is not the active
engine topology.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    Load[Document stream and parser] -->|static load and validation| Model[Loaded object graph]
    Model -. active ownership unknown .-> Requests[Transport and clip requests]
    Requests -. inferred descriptor association .-> Commands[Engine command handlers]
    Commands -. domain to scheduler join unknown .-> Scheduler[Beat and sample event queues]
    Commands -->|guarded prepare and same-local activation| Launch[Quantized launch preparation]
    Launch -. concrete receiver delivery unknown .-> Playback[MIDI audio and automation owners]
    Scheduler -. event implementation unknown .-> Playback
    Playback -. instantiated device-chain binding unknown .-> TrackOut[Local TrackOut construction and wiring]
    TrackOut -. processor instance dispatch unknown .-> Mix[Main and send processor wrappers]
    Launch -. recording writer unknown .-> Arrangement[Arrangement materialization]
    Arrangement -. save receiver unknown .-> Save[Generic XML and compressed output]
    Model -. public Save handler unknown .-> Save
    Save -. durability and reopen unknown .-> Load
    Export[RenderToDisk registration] -->|conditional stored callback and context| Gateway[Export gateway and opaque handles]
    Gateway -. renderer and encoder unknown .-> Delivery[Host or file delivery]
    Mix -. main and output destination unknown .-> Delivery
```

### Component boundaries, state and ownership

The source packets retain function-level records behind these grouped edges.
**Observed-static** identifies an expression/reference in a retained source;
**inferred** identifies its narrowly supported owner or association;
**unknown** identifies a missing join. None is a behavioral outcome grade.

| ID / scenario boundary | State/data and source-supported owner relationship | Evidence and qualification |
| --- | --- | --- |
| I-01 / document entry and parsing | The selected app branch passes file/path/configuration into the document loader, stream recognizer and XML reader. Parsed nodes become a returned root plus context. | [Document edges DOC-01–04](../../analysis/ableton-live-12.4.3/full-spec-v1/integration-structure-v1/document-component-edges.json): `1002e6e00 → 1018536d4 → 10148389c → 101484108 → 101486fe4`. Static references observed; file-type meaning, success and app receiver/slot predicates remain qualified. |
| I-02 / loaded root and validation | Root load writes the returned root handle, invokes post-load hooks and calls the recursive validation walk. Serialized Tracks/Scenes/Transport/DeviceChain membership supplies document structure. | [Document synthesis](../../analysis/ableton-live-12.4.3/full-spec-v1/integration-structure-v1/document-delivery.md), DOC-05, and [Live Set structure](live-set-structure.md#document-skeleton). Dynamic classes/hooks and publication into active playback/device objects remain unknown. |
| I-03 / transport request and engine state | Start calls the playing-command sender. Exact descriptor/registration evidence associates its word and three byte-like fields with the engine handler; that handler reaches the guarded engine-state path. | [Transport composition and inherited message associations](../../analysis/ableton-live-12.4.3/full-spec-v1/integration-structure-v1/transport-playback.md#boundary-composition-after-source-review): `10276a7b0 → 101a4abd8`, consumer `101a524b8 → 101a4ac8c → 101a4af58`. Sender/consumer association inferred with exact registration evidence; runtime queue delivery/order and domain-to-scheduler join unknown. The packet1a sender target keeps its receiver/vptr premises. |
| I-04 / quantized launch and activation | Clip-slot producer assembles launch settings. Engine Fire uses one local preparation record as input to activation; preparation stores two timing results and consults clock/quantization helpers. | [Transport boundary records](../../analysis/ableton-live-12.4.3/full-spec-v1/integration-structure-v1/transport-boundary-edges.json): producer `10245c72c → 102710290`; engine `101af0cbc → 101b0dc14`, with preparation and activation through the same local record. Guarded static relations observed; owner/timing meanings carried from T13. Public admission and producer-to-engine delivery remain unknown. |
| I-05 / scheduler events | The selected scheduler processes list/countdown state and dispatches due entries through virtual `+0x10`. | `101ab5cec`, [transport source synthesis](../../analysis/ableton-live-12.4.3/full-spec-v1/integration-structure-v1/transport-playback.md). Beat/sample-domain interpretation is qualified canonical evidence. Actual event classes, targets and audio-callback ordering are unknown; the OSend class proof cannot transfer to these receivers. |
| I-06 / MIDI, audio and automation preparation | MIDI preparation builds eight-byte time and 28-byte event arrays; the selected consumer branches on record kind. Audio parameter writing serializes controls/marker data. Float automation constructs a message with parallel time/value arrays. | [Transport source and boundary composition](../../analysis/ableton-live-12.4.3/full-spec-v1/integration-structure-v1/transport-playback.md). Concrete receiver/provider/instrument delivery and Warp resampling are unknown. ARM `10225b4e8` is a file-start-position calculation here, not proved voice activation. Existing value oracles are unchanged. |
| I-07 / local track-output construction | Named control/split/ramp and Volumes ports connect to TrackOut. Unit InL/R fields `+0x168/+0x170` reach the constructed TrackOut member `+0x428`; its outputs connect to local main/send/prehear/meter destinations. | [Nine source wiring edges and interfaces](../../analysis/ableton-live-12.4.3/full-spec-v1/integration-structure-v1/mix-component-edges.json), full builder `102731438` lines 1683–2016. Helper arguments observed; port-registration interpretation is qualified. Endpoint virtual targets, instantiated upstream chain and runtime routing remain unknown. Twelve construction iterations are not a global device/track limit. |
| I-08 / processor wrappers and main delivery | Selected main and send wrappers read referenced float inputs, update local state and write/accumulate referenced outputs. | [Mix synthesis](../../analysis/ableton-live-12.4.3/full-spec-v1/integration-structure-v1/mix-structure.md): `101b1c114` and `101b1afbc`. Their actual instance dispatch, bus ownership, global summation order and downstream host/export buffers remain unknown. |
| I-09 / recording into Arrangement | Documentary owners distinguish recording Session launches/property changes from newly recorded input/media. | [Recording boundary analysis](../../analysis/ableton-live-12.4.3/full-spec-v1/integration-structure-v1/mix-structure.md#explicit-remaining-integration-gaps) and [recording research](recording-comping.md). No selected native writer, state transition, timestamp ownership or undo/file transaction joins this stage. It remains an explicit unknown bridge. |
| I-10 / save and reopen | Generic format dispatch calls the XML envelope writer; it invokes member writing and compression setup/flush. | DOC-06–08 and [document synthesis](../../analysis/ableton-live-12.4.3/full-spec-v1/integration-structure-v1/document-delivery.md): `101485c50 → 101485240 → 1014339e4`. Public Save→actual song receiver, file replacement/durability and successful reopened state remain unknown. Generic reader/writer intersections do not prove a round trip. |
| I-11 / export command and gateway | RenderToDisk registration forwards a callback/context; the command constructor stores them at `+0x40/+0x48`. The selected eight-byte operand points to the named callback, whose indexed tail branch reaches a guarded gateway. | [Targeted callback bridge](../../analysis/ableton-live-12.4.3/full-spec-v1/integration-structure-v1/document-delivery.md#targeted-export-callback-bridge), DOC-09–13: data `106530bd8 → 100294f20`, retained branch to `10028dfcc`. This is a conditional source/data-linked association. Actual registry selection, stable fields, ABI/context and invocation are premises. It does not add an unconditional indirect target to packet1a. |
| I-12 / rendering and delivery | Gateway handle/view-like calls and a separate movie-backend body are available as landmarks. | [Document remaining predicates](../../analysis/ableton-live-12.4.3/full-spec-v1/integration-structure-v1/document-delivery.md#remaining-cross-component-predicates). Audio render buffers, range/track selection, encoder/file lifecycle and movie/audio pipeline composition remain unknown. No rendered output was observed. |

### Search scope and residual frontiers

[Shared search definitions](../../analysis/ableton-live-12.4.3/full-spec-v1/integration-structure-v1/README.md#shared-search-and-limits)
pin the predecessor and complete index identities. The top 1,000 destinations by
incoming index-row occurrences are pruned, with explicit seeds exempt. Each
direction accepts at most 200 edges and advances at most 80 nodes per level;
three levels are retained. The [reference census](../../analysis/ableton-live-12.4.3/full-spec-v1/integration-structure-v1/graph-reference-kinds.json)
separates 1,594,306 call-kind rows (including 485 override references) from 5,524
tail-jump rows. These are static index references, not runtime invocations.

Document, transport and mix parts retain respectively 168, 121 and 15 unresolved
indirect-site associations in considered functions. These are overlapping local
inventories, not an application total or a census of terminal unexpanded nodes.
Document traversal also leaves four then 32 node-budget omissions; the other
parts have no node/edge-budget omissions, while all retain hub pruning. Common
wiring/message helpers can be pruned hubs despite being semantically important;
selected complete source bodies retain those relationships explicitly.

Authors report reviewing each frontier before deeper expansion. Transport notes
retain UTC review values; document/mix notes establish hash-linked decisions but
do not independently establish wall-clock review ordering. The
[synthetic check](../../analysis/ableton-live-12.4.3/full-spec-v1/integration-structure-v1/trace-selfcheck-result.json)
exercises real search logic on owned fixtures, including depth progression,
unknown interior targets and hash rejection, without rerunning real graphs.

The first family maps must cite this integration context and classify the
owner's required outcomes as X-route, S-route or no established route under
ADR 0003. The unknown bridges above are not global impossibility findings.
No requirement/case/oracle, grade, complete profile/family or candidate result
changes with this map. Whole-product specification closure remains open.

17 with extracted-execution routes, 70 with static routes and 23 without an
established route. These are route inventory units, not behavior grades or a
whole-product denominator. Two auxiliary restatements and 13 explicit scope
gaps are separate from that count.

The mix cut follows I-07/I-08 from local port construction through TrackOut
wrapper reads, state updates and stores. Actual processor dispatch, bus/host
buffer ownership and final audible delivery remain unjoined. I-05/I-06 retain
automation provider/timebase premises; I-12 retains export delivery as unknown.

predicates. Thirty-six X2 curve setup rows patch original allocator sites and
retain the preparation/review gate; unpatched recorded scalar/model calls use
the standing execution rule. No original code ran for this map, and no public
waveform or application outcome gained credit.

## What is inside the application package

The application bundle is a directory containing the main executable, other
executables, native dependencies and resource trees. The following edges mean
only “contains.” All are observed in the pinned package inventory summarized in
the [bundle map](ableton-package-structure.md#bundle-map), backed by
[SRC-ABLETON-12-4-3](sources/ableton-live-12.4.3.md), INV/PKG and resource captures.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Live application bundle] -->|contains| B[Main Live executable]
    A -->|contains| C[Extensions and Push helpers]
    A -->|contains| D[Nested Max application]
    A -->|contains| E[Frameworks and Qt]

    F -->|contains| G[MIDI scripts and Python bytecode]
    F -->|contains| H[XML schemas and shipped sets]
    F -->|contains| I[QML and other interface resources]
```

Different executables are candidates for separate process boundaries. Packaging
alone does not show which run together, how they communicate, or which threads
handle audio. Native dependencies are modeled separately in the
[dependency evidence](../../analysis/ableton-live-12.4.3/dylib-resolution.json);
unresolved loads and partial coverage remain in the [package findings](ableton-package-structure.md#native-and-process-boundaries).

   start inside a component chosen in isolation, because nothing yet records how
   the components integrate. The first depth packet is one cross-component
   integration map of T1's first integrated scenario, traced end to end: document

   callbacks) follow the retained call index (`r2/c1-live-v1` calls, indirect,
   vtables and aliases, 1.6 M call edges; the browse per-function caller/callee
   lists) across every component the scenario crosses; record the state and
   data crossing each boundary and which component owns each transition. Family
   call-chain maps are then cut from the integration map, cite it, and classify
   each behavior in the owner's requirements as X-route (lives in self-contained
   functions), S-route (static only) or no-route under ADR 0003. Every structure
   packet updates the [program-structure atlas](program-structure.md) in the
   same change and feeds the route ledger (rule 5), and is reviewed once as a
   structure packet. A static call graph establishes neither execution order
   nor audio routing; mark each edge observed, inferred or unknown. Amended
   the same day: see [indirect-call resolution precedes the map](#amendment--indirect-call-resolution-precedes-the-map-2026-10-20).
2. **Batch grading.** An X packet grades one enumerated set in one harness
   sweep: all parameters and modes of a device, all U cases of a current
   release, or all leaf functions of one map. One frozen manifest, one
   independent review, one root catalog update. Single-case owner successors
   are not selectable except to record a reviewed blocking finding. Amended

   the existing [xexec harness](../../tools/xexec/xexec.py) with recorded inputs
   and recorded stubs, which [ADR 0003](../decisions/adr-0003-no-reference-execution.md#extracted-execution-of-original-code)

### Amendment — indirect-call resolution precedes the map (2026-10-20)

Measured on the retained `c1-live-v1` index before any structure packet was
selected: 1.6 M direct call edges over 323,567 functions; the highest in-degree
callees are allocators, guards and abort; with the top 1,000 hubs pruned, forward
reach from a typical function is about 2 functions after six hops and backward
reach about 8; 268,015 indirect call sites in 98,328 functions, of which 25,071
have a resolved target; 80 recovered vtables. The direct-call index does not
carry cross-component flow. Virtual dispatch does, and most of it is unresolved.
Rule 1 therefore runs with these prerequisites and this procedure:

1. **Component layer from symbols first.** Cluster functions by qualified alias
   labels (91,903 primary/symbol field occurrences, including repeated labels;
   39,700 `ableton::` occurrences, then `flip`, `boost`, `std`), the vtable
   symbols and the mangled type-name strings. The
   [atlas](program-structure.md#lexical-component-candidates) separates occurrence,
   distinct-label and function-entry units. This is the
   component inventory and class membership, produced without traversal.
2. **Resolve indirect calls at class level.** Recover vtables from constructor
   stores and RTTI in the retained exports and the binary; attach slot edges to
   every implementation. The structure packet reports the count of indirect sites
   with a resolved target (now 25,071 of 268,015) as its progress measure; the
   count is inventory, not coverage, and closes no outcome. A Ghidra re-export,
   if used, goes through the single native provider; no new tooling is installed
   for it ([ADR 0003](../decisions/adr-0003-no-reference-execution.md#extracted-execution-of-original-code)).
3. **Search bidirectionally and bounded.** Forward from the scenario's entry
   points (command registry, UI bridge, document load) and backward from known
   sinks (device render entries, the audio callback, the file writer); hubs
   pruned; iterative deepening with a per-level budget and a review of each
   frontier. An unresolved indirect site is recorded as an unknown edge, never
   treated as a dead end.
4. **Collapse to inter-component edges before drawing.** Function-level edges
   stay as evidence behind each component edge with observed, inferred or
   unknown status.
5. **Depth-first slicing only afterwards**, for specific paths through the
   component graph.

indirect-call resolution with the resolved count reported; 1b, the integration

# Full Live behavioral specification coverage design

## Authority and ownership

[ADR 0005](../decisions/adr-0005-full-live-specification-coverage.md) expands the
analyst target to all observable Live behavior. The existing
[schema](../schema.md), [workflows](../workflows.md),
[static-first policy](../decisions/adr-0002-static-first-analysis.md) and
[reference-execution boundary](../decisions/adr-0003-no-reference-execution.md)
govern every packet. This page owns the coverage method and completion gates;
the [execution plan](full-live-specification-plan.md) owns scheduling and status.
The [feature map](../specs/feature-map.md) routes behavior to canonical specs.
The [verification matrix](../verification/coverage.md) separately records that
no independent candidate comparison has run.

## Product denominator

Use the union of four separately retained inventories, reconciled without
silently dropping unmatched entries:

1. The official manual's chapters and behavioral subsections, pinned by capture
   bytes, URL, date and heading locator. Documentation establishes D behavior,
   with exact-build applicability unresolved unless independently corroborated.
2. The pinned installed product: native device types, schemas, preset classes,
   browser/content surfaces, helpers, settings, integrations and platform paths.
   Resource presence establishes a surface, not its signal behavior.
3. Existing research/specification requirement sets and their explicitly open
   interactions. Existing partial releases are retained as subsets.
4. Cross-cutting workflows: save/reopen, undo/redo, cancellation, failure/recovery,
   migration, automation, timing, randomization, accessibility and teardown.

Public API/object/event references refine the existing integration scope as a
separate overlapping inventory. [Current public API discovery](sources/cycling74-live-api.md)
records explicitly declared entries/members without assuming complete inheritance,
root/alias equivalence or target applicability from a newer reference revision.
Exact citation-to-topic links are navigation: even a reviewed partial clause citing
an exact source anchor does not close every behavior in that manual leaf.

Inventory identity is a stable product-surface ID plus a versioned source locator,
not a manual section number alone. Renumbered chapters retain a mapping; removed
or version-uncertain entries stay visible. Record entry counts for each inventory
and the reconciled union separately. A class or device list cannot claim to be
the complete behavior denominator.

The original manual inventory was extracted from numbered navigation links.
It is an open navigation baseline, not a census of every actual numbered chapter
heading or paragraph. Compare retained chapter HTML headings separately, preserving
capture identities, numbers/depth/anchors and source-proven ancestry. Additional
headings and paragraphs remain obligations even when the publisher omits them
from navigation. Keep original TOC rows/counts immutable and add reviewed discovery
companions. A typed structural ancestry relation is distinct from a literal direct-
anchor citation join; neither proves semantic/full-leaf coverage.

Source reconciliation must read each retained paragraph/list assertion and its
qualifiers, then compare its concrete predicate with the owning clause and case
action. A shared block citation, all-character assignment or matching heading
is insufficient. Distinguish represented documentary subsets, documented but
ungraded outcomes, missing clauses/case contexts, research-only explanations,
editorial text and uninspected images/linked destinations. Preserve source-silent
lifecycle obligations separately. A proposed absence test needs a genuinely active
positive baseline for the behavior under test; available input alone does not
prove the operation was running. A source audit identifies gaps and proposals;
only a preserved, separately reviewed owner successor adopts normative changes.

## Coverage states

| State | Required evidence | What it does not establish |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Inventoried | Versioned source proves an observable surface exists | A behavioral contract |
| Assigned | One canonical spec owner and a bounded question | Specified outcomes |
| Partial draft | Some supported requirements/cases; missing behavior enumerated | Complete feature coverage |
| Complete draft | All identified behavior and applicable lifecycle/case kinds have supported contracts; no required unknown outcome | Independent acceptance or implementation |
| Reviewed contract | Separate reviewer verifies scope, sources, case completeness and exclusions | Candidate compatibility |
| Released subset | Immutable sanitized package and pinned inventory | Anything outside its explicit finite scope |
| Candidate conformance | Exact candidate/build comparison report for the released cases | Original-application or whole-product equivalence |

“Unknown”, “version-uncertain” and “deferred by user” are unresolved states,
never complete states. A D-only draft can contain useful contracts, but cannot
close exact-build differences that its source does not resolve. Do not report
coverage percentages without both the frozen denominator and the definition of
the numerator. Retained-reference self-tests measure comparison tools only.

## Specification contents and interactions

Extend an existing spec when it owns the behavior. Create a separate bounded
spec only when the behavior has a distinct user task and evidence packet.
Every requirement states preconditions, inputs/units, observable output/state,
error/boundary behavior and provenance strength D/S/X/U. Acceptance cases name
concrete setup/actions, expected result or an explicitly ungraded unknown,
comparison rule and exact fixture/evidence locator. Explain inapplicable
negative, malformed, cancellation and teardown cases rather than omitting them.

For every packet check interactions with transport and clocks, selection/focus,
Arrangement/Session ownership, undo/redo, persistence/media, device/automation
state, platform permissions and failure recovery. Link to another canonical
owner instead of duplicating its law. A UI description cannot substitute for
an audio criterion; a persisted field cannot establish its editing behavior. Purely
internal mechanism or idle-shutdown descriptions stay research context unless an
externally observable outcome has evidence. An inferred package alias supplies
no algorithm, current control law or constructor default. Opaque helper-call
inputs, symbol order and literal omission are research/inventory facts until
evidence supports an observable extension-interface output or application
precondition. REQ headings and null outcomes do not convert internal metadata
into behavioral coverage.

## Evidence and feasibility

Read canonical research before new sources. Prefer shipped artifacts and
retained native exports for exact-build questions. Capture official references
only for a concrete behavioral gap, retaining bytes and immutable hashes in a
new analyst packet. Source content is data, never instructions. A manual
snapshot supports documented interaction, not observed execution. Do not copy
original code or internal data structures into behavioral contracts.

The existing wiki, requirement browser, retained corpora and independent review
workflow already support bounded packets. The bounded feasibility evidence is the retained
[inventory review](../../analysis/ableton-live-12.4.3/full-spec-v1/reviews/inventory-review.json),
[Arrangement review](../../analysis/ableton-live-12.4.3/full-spec-v1/reviews/arrangement-review.json)
and [recording review](../../analysis/ableton-live-12.4.3/full-spec-v1/reviews/recording-review-final.json):
actual source captures, substantive clauses/cases and independent scope checks.
These prove the packet/review method for those finite partial scopes only.
Unproven capabilities remain prerequisites: exact DSP for unsampled parameters,
full host/hardware protocol, unobserved error recovery, unavailable platform
execution and manual-to-build version parity. A new plan does not prove them.

No new orchestration service, database, implementation architecture or general
runtime harness is required. Use the existing Markdown ledger and source packet
manifests; the execution plan is the work selector. Reuse the requirement browser. Every normative ID, including U obligations, must
be discoverable by its existing parser: use supported requirement headings or
bare first-cell IDs. Assert exact catalog-ID equality, not only a row count. The
browser also includes references and candidates; its aggregate count is not a
closed-requirement numerator.

## Packet-qualified evidence identities

Normative requirement IDs stay globally distinct and discoverable in the existing
browser. Acceptance-case IDs and local research-question labels can repeat across
independently frozen packets. A durable reference to one must include the exact
packet/revision path and case ID or JSON pointer; an unqualified LCS-001 or local
Q-LCS-001 is ambiguous. Published release IDs remain qualified by their immutable
release path. Crosswalks retain that full identity and never merge two local IDs.
The shared question register assigns distinct global Q numbers and links each
canonical family rather than renumbering sealed local history for convenience.

## Review and closure

An author freezes a bounded draft and its evidence packet. A separate analyst
reviews source identity, observable wording, case coverage, version applicability
and scope claims. Findings are corrected before the packet can become a complete
draft or reviewed contract. Release review additionally sanitizes the package
under the existing workflow. Root integrates indexes, coverage, questions and
append-only log together. Review of an explicitly partial analyst draft confirms
only its supported source/scope/case subset; it does not move the whole packet to
Complete draft or imply missing outcomes passed. Historical/dated manuals retain
their exact version and source context rather than inheriting current-build parity.

Preserve earlier author seals, payloads, canonical snapshots and review records
when correcting a frozen draft. Add a successor revision with a narrow delta and
independent re-review. Integrity checks must not rewrite sealed validation results
or sources while verifying them; record a new check result outside the frozen
payload instead. Hash checks establish byte identity, not behavioral correctness.

When a current canonical changes, enumerate frozen consumers of its former bytes.
Retain old catalogs and canonical snapshots, and qualify historical mappings by
revision. A frozen checker comparing an older snapshot to an evolving wiki is
historical after that wiki advances; its old pass remains valid only for the
original revision. Verify the current successor with its own pinned sources,
exact delta and independent review. Enumerating historical consumers does not
require rerunning or adapting all their checkers after every editorial/additive
advance. Preserve their bytes and report mechanical applicability separately from
changed behavioral assumptions. Mark only actually changed semantic assumptions
stale; unchanged source laws and old navigation retain their bounded meaning.

Replay a historical checker when a concrete current dependency question, failed
required check or release gate needs that result. Then use exactly pinned
historical snapshots through an explicitly disclosed narrow successor checker;
do not rewrite old pins/results or treat historical replay as current semantic
approval. No generic resolver/registry, automatic adapter per owner revision or
new queue is required. An unchanged source hash or old partial review cannot
approve newly added clauses or case branches.

Author-freeze descriptions of review status are explicitly as-of that freeze;
current review disposition routes through the existing spec/research index and
immutable review. Do not publish an unqualified current pending-review assertion
that must be patched into another frozen revision solely after approval.

Whole-product specification closure requires independent review that all
inventory entries have correct canonical owners, all supported behavior is
specified with acceptance cases, all cross-feature workflows are covered and
no unresolved required behavior is concealed by exclusions. Exclusions must be
explicitly authorized changes to the target, not analyst convenience. Until
then the overall target remains in progress even when a useful batch is done.

- **Structure packet.** A reviewable unit whose output is a call-chain map:
  entry points, components, boundary state and data, and a route class per
  required behavior (X, S, none). The first call-chain map is the cross-component
  integration map of the T1 scenario, preceded by the amended component/indirect

  so no component is mapped before its integration context exists. Edges cite the retained call index or a
  function page and carry observed, inferred or unknown status as the atlas
  requires. A map supports route classification and batch enumeration only; it
  grades no outcome and does not turn internal mechanism into observable behavior.
- **Batch evidence packet.** One frozen manifest listing every harness call
  (slice sha256, address, inputs, stubs, harness source hash, timeout, result)
  and the grades it supports; one independent review covers the batch. Per-call
  evidence identity (revision 5) and the X label with its arm64 inference caveat
  (ADR 0003) are unchanged.
- **Standing authorization class.** Self-contained calls through the existing
  harness with recorded inputs and stubs. Anything that patches code, constructs
  original objects beyond the harness model or needs new tooling keeps per-run
  preparation and peer review.
- **Route ledger.** Per family, counts of required outcomes by route class. It
  is inventory, reported alongside the revision 9 numerator; it never closes an
  outcome.
- **Checks and pinning.** Checkpoint replays cover payloads changed since the
  last passing run, applying revision 8's rule to the mechanical checks; a full
  replay precedes a release. Successors pin the predecessor manifest hash rather
  than copying spec snapshots.

Completion rule confirmed by the user on2026-10-20: required behavior without

owns this rule; a documentary inventory of unknowns grants no completion credit.

## Revision 12 — review-once batch adoption and authorization scope — 2026-10-21

Plan revision 4's [second amendment](full-live-specification-plan.md#second-amendment--batch-adoption-authorization-scope-and-x-count-ordering-2026-10-21)
measured nine hours of structure and batch work and found about 2,700 harness
calls with no adopted expectation, up to nine gate files per packet, and most
packets in families whose ledgers show no X route. This revision changes the
review and authorization forms so that evidence converts; it changes no
denominator, seal rule, closure gate or execution authorization.

- **Review once.** An observation is independently reviewed once, in its batch
  or structure packet. Later artifacts cite that review by manifest hash; they
  do not re-review the observation. A packet whose calls are all self-contained
  harness calls or static reads of retained bytes is one frozen manifest and
  one independent review; preflight, readiness, selection and receipt records
  are not created for it. The preparation and peer chain of revision 11 remains
  for patched code, original object construction beyond the harness model, or
  new tooling.
- **Batch adoption.** Approval of a batch review admits its observations into
  the owner's next revision: an agreement with the recorded oracle becomes that
  case's expectation with extracted-execution provenance; an evaluation without
  an oracle becomes the expectation of a new case with the same provenance and
  ADR 0003's arm64 inference caveat; a mismatch becomes a correction through
  the violated requirement. The owner-revision review covers only what the
  revision adds beyond the batch. Releases stay immutable and keep their review.
- **Ledger totals.** The route ledger of revision 11 is reported as totals
  across all family cuts (X, S, none) in every checkpoint, next to the
  resolved-indirect count; counts only, never a fraction. Under the confirmed
  completion rule a predicate without a route stays U and keeps closure open.
- **Yield ordering.** Batches and outside-scenario maps are selected by ledger
  X count; a family with no X route is not selectable for depth until a map
  revision adds one.
